field.name: effectiveOwners
field.type: ReadonlyArray<Readonly<{ callId: string; rootArtifactId: string | null; artifactId: string | null; ownerVersion: string | null; captureRootArtifactId: string; captureArtifactId: string; basisEventIds: readonly string[]; provenanceEventIds: readonly string[]; state: 'resolved' | 'pending' | 'conflict' | 'unavailable' }>>
field.purpose: Add this field to EffectiveAccounting: typed effective per-call attribution with owner version, immutable capture owner and provenance. New s1 reducer results always populate it; old consumers may ignore the optional field. Grouping consumers must treat absence as attribution unavailable, never fall back to capture-owner IDs.

body.rationale: LLD review round 2 identified that sc1 computes ownership changes but its base result exposes only token totals/basis IDs. A single optional typed field makes same-root and cross-root results consumable by s2/s3/s4/TU4 without parsing notices or guessing capture ownership. No method signatures, ownership, dependency, storage or rollout scope change. Pending explicit amendment approval; not silently applied to the approved HLD.
